items.title: George Benson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He said, “George, I’m in New York, and we’re making a record. Can you come down to the studio?”

ctx.x: In the middle of the night – he called me up about 1 o’clock in the morning. He said, “George, I’m in New York, and we’re making a record. Can you come down to the studio?” I said, “It’s 1 o’clock.” He said, “No, we’re going to be here all night. If you could come. Just do this one song.” I’m glad I did. I got up because of who he is. I always loved him, and his playing is impeccable. I went down to the studio. He had this song called Space Age Blues or something like that. They was space age, too. So I said, I…
You’re going to start your own career as a leader with Columbia, starting to record. I just want to wrap up. You left Jack McDuff when, and why?
